title: Account settings
description: Your profile, preferences and security. These apply across every workspace you’re in.

profile.title: Profile
profile.description: How you appear to other people in your workspaces.
profile.name: Name
profile.avatarHint: Orqivanta shows your initials in this colour. No photo uploads in this release.
profile.emailVerified: Verified. Contact support to change the address on your account.
profile.emailUnverified: Not verified yet — check your inbox for the confirmation link.

preferences.title: Preferences
preferences.description: Language, theme and how dates are shown.
preferences.timeZoneHint: Due dates, reports and timestamps use this zone.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.description: Choose what reaches you, and where. In-app notifications appear in your inbox.
notifications.caption: Notification preferences by category and channel
notifications.footnote: Some messages always arrive by email: password changes, invitations and security notices.

security.passwordDescription: Changing your password signs out your other devices.
security.signsOutOthers: Your other sessions end as soon as the password changes.
security.demoNotice: Demo accounts can’t change their password.
security.sessionsDescription: Devices signed in to your account. Revoke anything you don’t recognise.
security.signOutOthersBody: {count, plural, one {# other session ends} other {# other sessions end}}. You stay signed in here.
security.othersRevoked: Your other sessions were signed out

twoFactor.title: Two-factor sign-in
twoFactor.description: Ask for a code from an authenticator app after your password.
twoFactor.offBody: With two-factor sign-in on, someone who learns your password still can’t get in without your phone. Any authenticator app works, for example 1Password, Google Authenticator or Authy.
twoFactor.demoNotice: Demo accounts are shared, so two-factor sign-in is turned off for them. Create your own account to try it.
twoFactor.step1: Scan the QR code with your authenticator app, or type in the key.
twoFactor.step2: Enter the 6-digit code the app shows to finish.
twoFactor.qrLabel: QR code for your authenticator app
twoFactor.codesOnce: Save these recovery codes somewhere safe. Each one signs you in once if you lose your phone, and you won’t see them again.
twoFactor.copyFailed: Couldn’t copy. Select the codes and copy them instead.
twoFactor.codesLeft: {count, plural, =0 {No recovery codes left.} one {# recovery code left.} other {# recovery codes left.}}
twoFactor.codesLow: You’re almost out of recovery codes. Make new ones so you don’t get locked out.
twoFactor.disableBody: Enter your password to turn off two-factor sign-in. Your recovery codes stop working too.
twoFactor.regenerateBody: Enter your password to make ten new recovery codes. The old ones stop working.
